description: This file contains unit tests for FastAPI dependencies, testing the behavior of various dependency injection mechanisms with partial functions, including synchronous, asynchronous, generator-based, callable classes, and methods. It defines mock dependency functions and classes, FastAPI endpoint handlers that use these dependencies via Depends with partial application, and a pytest-based test suite verifying the correct dependency resolution and response output.

classes.description: A class with a __call__ method that returns the provided string value.

classes.description: An asynchronous class with a __call__ method that returns a string value.

classes.description: A class containing various synchronous and asynchronous methods returning or yielding string values.
